command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-specs#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1 resolution harms: task 10.3 (tasks.md:65) has the H3 patch add a sentence to the 'Contract tests' rule under '## Decision' of the accepted docs/adr/0005-view-registry.md (line 45, Status 'Accepted (2026-09-28)'), which .claude/rules/adr.md:52 forbids: 'Never edit an accepted ADR to change the decision — create a new one with `Superseded by ADR-YYYY`'. The repository's pattern is a refining ADR that states 'Refines [ADR-XXXX]' (ADR-0007:8, ADR-0011:6) with only a Status-line pointer in the older ADR (ADR-0003:4 'Accepted (2026-09-28). Refined by [ADR-0007]…'). The patch also leaves ADR-0005:62 'A new view cannot skip the contract scenarios' and :56 'Nothing else changes: … contract tests pick it up' contradicting the added sentence. Rework H3 (task 10.3, D11's last bullet, Human follow-up H3, proposal What Changes/Impact) so the capability-scoped contract rule is recorded by an ADR that states it (e.g. a new ADR via handoff patch saying 'Refines ADR-0005'), and ADR-0005 gets at most a Status-line 'Refined by' pointer.

The H3 patch text 'Refined by [ADR-0011](0011-meeting-range-in-grid-view.md): contract scenarios of a capability a view does not show … run only for the views that show it' credits the rule to ADR-0011, but ADR-0011 does not decide it (its only refinement note is 'Refines ADR-0003' at line 6, and it says nothing about contract scenarios). The pointer must name an ADR that actually contains the decision.
